title: DocumentProcessed
description: Event emitted by document-intelligence when a raw artifact has been processed into a canonical document.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this event instance.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event was emitted.

document_id.description: ID of the canonical document that was produced.

source_id.description: ID of the source for lineage traceability.

run_id.description: ID of the run for lineage traceability.

artifact_id.description: ID of the raw artifact that was processed.

version.description: Processing pipeline version or schema version.

canonical_path.description: Delta table path or location of the canonical document record.

sections_produced.description: Number of sections produced, if any.

citations_produced.description: Number of citations extracted, if any.
